subject: secr 4.5.10 and secrdesign 2.8.2 now on CRAN

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: secr 4.5.10 and secrdesign 2.8.2 now on CRAN
parts: New versions of secr and secrdesign are now available on CRAN. These include the incremental changes noted in earlier posts. Note especially the bug fix in secr.fit for Poisson count detectors when fastproximity = FALSE, and new function estimateSummary() in secrdesign.
